name: Hidden Math Gems
author: Addicting Games
description: Hidden Math Gems is an educational game for learning students to play. Math does not have to be a bore! Use this online game to break up your math sessions with a good old-fashioned clicker game. The objective of the game is to help this archaeologist dig through various blocks to find treasures and gems. There rubies, emeralds, pearls, and other precious stones that are hiding through blocks. Certain blocks will be tougher to get through while others will be easy. Some blocks will not let you get through so you will have to figure another way down. Whatever you do, do not let the archaeologist hit the top of the game or you lose. Once you have played a fun session of Hidden Math Gems, practice your math by answering 5 math skills correctly to unlock the next game.
